title: Holder Cancellation of a Kessler GAP Waiver
content:
# Holder Cancellation of a Kessler GAP Waiver

**Product:** Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda (all six waivers, from Kessler GAP Waiver 125 to Kessler GAP Commercial 130).

## Situation this entry governs

This policy prices the cancellation refund booked when the holder confirms the submitted signed cancellation request recorded for an active waiver. The result it governs is the cancellation refund that is booked as due on the waiver at the moment of cancellation.

How an active waiver ends:

| What the waiver's records show | How the waiver ends |
|---|---|
| A submitted signed cancellation request is recorded for the waiver (whether or not the lienholder has reported a loan payoff date) | By the holder's cancellation |
| A loan payoff date is on file and no submitted signed cancellation request is recorded | By termination |

For an active waiver that carries a submitted signed cancellation request, and only for such a waiver, the holder's cancellation ends the waiver even where its lienholder has reported the contract paid off or refinanced away. Every other waiver whose contract the lienholder reports paid off, or refinanced away where the tier's refinance switch ends the waiver, is terminated with its refund computed without any request where the tier computes payoff refunds automatically.

## Business effect of the cancellation

Once the holder confirms, the request is marked completed, the waiver moves to cancelled status with the effective date of the cancellation as its closing date, a refund calculation entry for the refund amount and its refund basis is booked on the waiver's ledger dated on that effective date, and the waiver's refund due rises by that amount.

## Invocation: `confirm_gap_cancellation_0d8763f7`

This is a customer-owned tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to confirm their own signed request; the agent does not run it on the holder's behalf.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `gap_waiver_id` | Reference number of the GAP waiver being cancelled, as returned by the GAP waiver lookup for this holder | Id |
| `gap_cancel_request_id` | Reference number of the holder's signed cancellation request on file for this waiver in submitted status, as returned by the cancellation request lookup | Id |
| `effective_date` | The date the cancellation takes effect; it becomes the waiver's closing date and the date of the refund calculation entry | YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, no time or time zone |
| `cancel_method` | The basis of the refund | Exactly one of the values below |
| `refund_amount` | The refund owed on the cancellation in US dollars | Non-negative, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (a half cent goes up); 0.00 when no refund is owed |

Values of `cancel_method`:
- `flat_free_look` — the cancellation falls inside the free-look window and the full price comes back;
- `flat_deal_unwound` — the waiver's purchase deal was unwound and the full price comes back;
- `pro_rata` — any other cancellation, refunded for the unused part of the term;
- `not_applicable` — reserved for ledger entries that are not refund calculations; never the basis of a cancellation refund and refused by this tool.

## Return

On success the holder sees one line: "Cancellation confirmed: waiver <gap_waiver_id> cancelled effective <effective_date>; refund calculation <entry id> booked for <amount> USD (<cancel_method>); request <gap_cancel_request_id> completed." The entry id is the new refund calculation entry's reference number and the amount is shown with 2 decimals. Receiving this line means the cancellation and its refund calculation are recorded.

A line starting "Error:" means nothing was written. The tool returns it when the request reference does not name a request in submitted status recorded for this same waiver, when the date is not a real calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, when the refund basis is not one of the three accepted values, or when the amount is negative.
